featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Big Little Bombay recently and overall the pizza was the strongest part of the experience. The taste, cheese balance, and flavor were genuinely very good, and for pizza lovers this is definitely the item worth ordering. From my side, pizza deserves 5/5 because it was the one item that matched expectations well. 🍕⭐

However, there are some important things to know before visiting. The AC seating space is very limited, so during busy hours or weekends the place can feel crowded and uncomfortable. Because of weekend rush, service was slow and overall food consistency was not perfect. Some items did not feel as properly prepared as expected, and staff coordination also seemed affected by crowd.

Payment convenience is another point to note: Zomato payment was not available, which may be inconvenient for customers who usually depend on app-based payment options or offers.

The cold coffee was disappointing and did not work at all for me — 0/5. ☕❌ It lacked taste and felt below standard.

Dessert was the biggest disappointment. The brownie dessert looked attractive in the showcase/photos, so expectations were naturally high, but the actual serving was completely different. The presentation felt messy, the taste was poor, and overall it did not justify ordering at all. The ice cream combination also did not blend properly with the brownie, making it one of the weakest items on the table. ❌🍨 From my experience, this dessert is something I would strongly recommend skipping.

Overall, this place is worth visiting mainly for pizza, but best on a non-weekend day if you want a better experience. Pizza is highly recommended, while cold coffee and brownie dessert need major improvement.
